title: Understanding Headaches
content: A headache is pain or discomfort in the head or face. Common causes can include stress, dehydration, lack of sleep, skipped meals, eye strain, infections, and migraine. Different types of headaches can have different causes. Rest, hydration, regular meals, and reducing stress may help some mild headaches. A sudden, severe headache or a headache accompanied by symptoms such as confusion, weakness, difficulty speaking, loss of consciousness, or significant vision changes may require urgent medical attention. Persistent or worsening headaches should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.
